item.title: LA Supervisors Unanimously Approve Creating ‘ICE-Free Zones’ at County-Owned Facilities
item.description: The county Board of Supervisors unanimously directed its attorneys Tuesday to draft an ordinance creating “ICE-Free Zones” to prevent county facilities from being used as staging areas or processing centers by federal immigration-enforcement authorities. item.title: Deputy, Suspect Injured in Palmdale Shooting; Both Expected to Survive
item.description: A Los Angeles County sheriff’s deputy and a suspect both sustained non-life-threatening injuries Tuesday in a shooting in Palmdale.
